name: Seville (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the yellow monogram NO8DO, the 8 in the form of a skein of wool.
history: The motto of the city, present on numerous buildings, is NO8DO, where the 8 takes the form of a skein of wool (madeja), read as 'no me ha dejado' (it has not abandoned me).

features.role: monogram NO8DO with a skein of wool at the centre
